name: evaluate
title_zh: 代码合不合规，它把裁决权交回你手里
tagline_zh: 检查文件、目录或本次改动是否违反项目约定；发现冲突时它不擅改，而是给出修代码或改约定两条路，由你拍板。
tagline_en: Checks files, dirs, or your latest diff against project conventions; when rules clash, it proposes fixing code or.
desc_en: Evaluate code — a file, directory, or the session's change — against the project's conventions; recommends fixing the code or amending the convention, and the user rules on each. Use when checking conformance, before imitating existing code, or when a rule seems stale or missing; not for bugs or general quality.
why_zh: 把「约定」当成可协商的活物：代码不合规时，它不假装中立，而是逼你选择是迁就代码还是修订规则。
why_en: Treats conventions as living agreements: on conflict, it forces a conscious choice—bend the code or amend the rule—so standards.
limit_zh: 只处理「是否符合项目约定」这一件事，不查 bug、不评代码质量；需要你已定义约定（如 linter 配置、风格指南）。
limit_en: Only checks conformance to existing conventions—no bug hunting or quality review. Requires you to have defined rules (linter config, style guide).
title_en: Code conformance checker that lets you rule
